_comment: Zod schema drift baseline between lib/api/schemas.ts and lib/api/schemas/* (#1883). The MONOLITH (lib/api/schemas.ts) is canonical for every schema with live importers; the submodule copies under lib/api/schemas/* were partially migrated and had drifted. As of #1883 all known drift has been reconciled — the submodule copies are now byte-identical to the monolith (or, for the 2FA verify/disable schemas, the monolith's dead copies were removed in favour of the live lib/api/schemas/auth.ts versions). This baseline is now EMPTY: the guard (scripts/check-schema-drift.mjs) FAILS on ANY drift. Do not add entries back without a documented reason.
